title: Trump fires Kristi Noem. And, DOJ releases some missing Epstein files
summary: President Trump has fired DHS Secretary Kristi Noem and named Sen. Markwayne Mullin as her replacement. And, the Justice Department released some missing Epstein files.
contentText:
President Trump has fired DHS Secretary Kristi Noem and named Sen. Markwayne Mullin as her replacement. And, the Justice Department released some missing Epstein files.

(Image credit: Mandel Ngan, Drew Angerer)
